events.subtitle: Red Hook Records 5th Anniversary — Night Two
events.factual_description: Roulette presents the second night of Red Hook Records' fifth-anniversary residency on September 19, 2026 at 8:00 PM, with doors at 7:00 PM. Set 1 is Caroline Davis on alto saxophone, Qasim Naqvi on drums and Grey Mcmurray on guitar. Set 2 is Jason Moran on piano, BlankFor.ms on electronics and Marcus Gilmore on drums; Roulette identifies Shards (Red Hook, 2026) as a collaborative album by those three musicians. Tickets are listed at $40 advance, $45 at the door, and $30 student/senior. Roulette also announces a free live stream at showtime with an archived stream afterward.

en.why_it_matters: Night Two turns Red Hook's fifth anniversary into two sharply different improvising environments. Davis, Naqvi and Mcmurray put alto, drums and guitar in one frame; Moran, BlankFor.ms and Gilmore bring the piano-electronics-drums language documented on Shards into the room together. The label-anniversary context matters because it makes the evening a live snapshot of Red Hook's boundary-crossing aesthetic rather than a generic multi-artist bill.
en.trip_verdict: If New York is viable that Saturday, actively make room for Roulette and let it anchor the evening. From farther down the corridor, it is strongest as part of a Brooklyn/New York weekend rather than as a one-show trip by itself.

es.why_it_matters: La segunda noche convierte el quinto aniversario de Red Hook en dos espacios de improvisación muy distintos. Davis, Naqvi y Mcmurray juntan alto, batería y guitarra; Moran, BlankFor.ms y Gilmore llevan al escenario el lenguaje de piano, electrónica y batería documentado en Shards. El marco del aniversario sí importa: hace de la noche una instantánea en vivo de la estética fronteriza del sello y no una simple cartelera de buenos nombres.
es.trip_verdict: Si Nueva York es viable ese sábado, le haría espacio activamente a Roulette y dejaría que ordene la noche. Desde más abajo del corredor, funciona mejor dentro de un fin de semana en Brooklyn/Nueva York que como viaje dedicado a un solo concierto.
